x: Although Ray Middleton was the declared winner he felt little satisfaction in receiving the award, for McCullagh and Wallwork were certain of first two places when they went off course in the closing stages.

McCullagh and Wallwork made no mistake this time, keeping on course and pushing our own Ray Middleton back to third place; it should not be forgotten though that Ray, as a 50 Kilos man, is taking these men on at their own shorter distance game.

Several of the 188 starters came under the judges' ban and Met WC lost McCullagh and Watts, a set-back from which they did well to recover. Others to be'pulled' were Paddick (RSC) and Hart, the Welsh champion.
Altogether this happened on eight occasions between April 20th and August 6th, the victors being Nihill (twice), Read (twice), Thompson, McCullagh, Brooks and Wallwork.
